newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to higher.

text.p: CME live and feeder cattle futures alike, were expected to open steady to 0.100 cent per lb higher, traders said.

Live cattle futures should remain technically strong and further fund buying was expected in most months despite expectations that cash beef and cattle markets may be near a top. Some analysts still expect cash cattle to trade another $1 per cwt higher next week which will likely support August, they said.
The August options expiration will be closely watched as there is a large open interest in the 68 strike and futures above this level would spark heavy short covering, some sources noted.

Feeder cattle futures were expected to show carryover demand following a weak trend to corn futures overnight and lower corn futures indications Friday morning. This should encourage increased interest for feeders, analysts said.
They added that even though the latest CME feeder cattle index was lower, it is still holding at the highest levels since early 1996.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was off $0.15 at $82.31 per cwt.
